about: Sainte-Marie is a city in Quebec’s Chaudière-Appalaches region, in the Beauce on the Rivière Chaudière south of Québec City. Agri-food industry, a Beauce commercial hub role, and Appalachian valley setting define the community often called Sainte-Marie-de-Beauce. About 14,000 people live in Sainte-Marie.
